blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 47 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (September 15, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: MATR & DELL lead 47 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 28 Canadian and 19 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: This week's Benchmark Beaters screen found 47 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 28 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 12 of them new to the list this week. Mattr Corp. (MATR) leads with a +127% six-month return, and Materials is the most represented sector with 15 names.

In the U.S., 19 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 11 of them new to the list this week. Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL) leads with a +255% six-month return, and Information Technology is the most represented sector with 7 names.
Download the full table for every name, and the chart pack to see how each one's relative strength has built over six months and ten years.
